Spacecraft name Corvus-HD (Landmapper-HD)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 16U
Organisation Astro Digital
Institution Company
Entity type Commercial
Headquarters US
Manufacturer AIVT by Astro Digital
Partners Astro Digital
Oneliner

Commercial constellation providing multispectral Earth observation data.
Description

High quality multispectral sensors that provide for automated identification of ground features such as crop types, their vigor, and stage in the growing cycle with a resolution of 2.5 meters per pixel. Multispectral: Red, Green, Blue, NIR, Red Edge
